editorial.marketOverview: Reuters confirms Monday Nasdaq rose about 6.5% and Nvidia 31.5%. Secondary closing data reports Russell 2000 +3.40% and Micron +19.04%, suggesting participation beyond the largest AI name, though not direct advance-decline breadth. VIX is reported at 26.85 versus 27.05 elsewhere; official close not verified.
editorial.whatChanged: Closing data now corroborates the broader recovery and provides a reported 10Y yield of 4.918%. Open Watch remains 177 events, updated 22:27 UTC; no new curated catalyst. No verified overnight US futures observation changes the path.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The rebound is broad enough to support the existing reversal attempt, but concentrated index contributions and elevated volatility leave squeeze risk. Reuters reports hawkish Fed bets; primary probabilities and paired yields are missing. Brent reportedly fell to $86.72, but contract details and synchronized WTI are absent.
editorial.threeDayPath: Tuesday November 24 tests Monday's rebound with ADI earnings, consumer confidence and Dell after the close. Wednesday November 25 brings PCE, GDP, claims and Beige Book, with Dell's reaction in cash trading. Thursday is closed; Friday November 27 is a shortened session with thin liquidity and advance economic indicators. The base case remains cautiously bullish but vulnerable to reversal.
editorial.bullCase: Holding Monday's gains with positive SOX relative strength, broader advancing issues, lower VXN/VIX and stable yields would turn the reversal attempt into credible follow-through. Dell demand commentary could help if positive; no outcome is yet known.
editorial.bearCase: Failure to retain Monday's gains, semiconductor underperformance, or a VXN/VIX rebound would imply a short-covering squeeze. Stronger inflation and higher yields could accelerate a reversal.
editorial.watchNext: Check Tuesday cash QQQ/NDX and SOX, advance-decline breadth, VXN/VIX closes, 2Y and 10Y synchronized correctly scaled yields, FedWatch primary probabilities, matched Brent/WTI contracts, consumer confidence and Dell earnings. Recheck curated Open Watch for genuinely new catalysts. Friday closes at 13:00 ET; avoid interpreting thin holiday liquidity as robust breadth.
